description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project for handling platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures for the RT288X platform, including functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade based on the board type, defaulting to a generic upgrade method.
